name: nvim
purpose: Mike Dacre's Vim-first configuration, shared with NeoVim, deployed from one git repo to every machine

runtime.primary: Vim 9 — MacVim (GUI) and terminal vim, on many machines
runtime.secondary: Neovim 0.12+, an in-progress migration, never at Vim's expense
runtime.hard_constraint: LOSING VIM SUPPORT IS UNACCEPTABLE. Vim is the primary editor, not the fallback. Any change that works only in Neovim must be additive and guarded; any change that degrades the Vim path is rejected outright, regardless of how much nicer the Neovim version is.

git.note: ~/nvim and ~/.config/nvim are the same directory; ~/.vim and ~/.vimrc symlink into it

deps.name: vim-plug
deps.why: only plugin manager that works in both Vim 9 and Neovim; :PlugSnapshot gives reproducible pinning. vim.pack (nvim 0.12 core) and lazy.nvim are Neovim-only and were rejected for that reason.

deps.name: panvimdoc
deps.why: renders README.md into doc/mikevim.txt so `:help mikevim` is the recall surface in BOTH editors. Submodule rather than pinned package because panvimdoc.sh is invoked directly and may need patching. Requires pandoc at doc-build time only; the generated file is committed, so a fresh clone needs neither.

connectors.name: Desktop Commander
connectors.use: shell, file edits and git inside the working copy
connectors.fallback: Filesystem read-only + hand the user ONE idempotent script

connectors.name: Filesystem
connectors.use: read-only inspection when Desktop Commander is hung
connectors.fallback: ask the user to paste file contents

connectors.name: web_search
connectors.use: verify plugin maintenance status and upstream breaking changes before proposing a change
connectors.fallback: state that the claim is unverified and do not act on it

skills.name: plugin-audit
skills.trigger: cull plugins, plugin bloat, do I still need, dual-editor coverage

skills.name: docs-regen
skills.trigger: update the cheatsheet, regenerate help, :help mikevim is stale

secrets.note: none declared; priv/ exists for per-machine overrides only

hazards: nvim-treesitter was archived 2026-04-03; master is frozen, main is an incompatible rewrite. plugins.vim declares it TWICE. Do not update it casually.
plugged/ is 2.6GB and gitignored. Never commit it.
The checkout IS the runtimepath: a syntax error in init.vim breaks the editor on every machine at next pull.

MacVim syncs Vim upstream on a lag (r183 = Vim 9.2 patches 1-332). Two command-injection CVEs are reported unfixed on its tracker, one in tag-file handling. Relevant here because taglist.vim and tag sessions are in daily use.

editors.note: MacVim's GUI is materially better than every Neovim macOS GUI tried so far; that gap, not plugin capability, is what gates the migration

resolved_questions.oni: dead as of 2026-09-04 — config.js to be removed
resolved_questions.vim-go-fork: no remaining reason — return to upstream
resolved_questions.vim9-machines: many; Vim is primary, Neovim is the migration target
